verses.original: וַיִּקְח֞וּ כָּל־ עַ֤ם יְהוּדָה֙ אֶת־ עֻזִּיָּ֔הוּ וְה֕וּא בֶּן־ שֵׁ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה וַיַּמְלִ֣יכוּ אֹת֔וֹ תַּ֖חַת אָבִ֥יו אֲמַצְיָֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·ḥū kāl- ‘am yə·hū·ḏāh ’eṯ- ‘uz·zî·yā·hū wə·hū ben- šêš ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh way·yam·lî·ḵū ’ō·ṯōw ta·ḥaṯ ’ā·ḇîw ’ă·maṣ·yā·hū
verses.literal: All the people of Judah took Uzziah who was sixteen . . . years old . . . and made him king in place of his father Amaziah
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO todo o povo tomou a Uzias, que tinha dezesseis anos, e o fizeram rei em lugar de Amazias seu pai.

verses.original: ה֚וּא בָּנָ֣ה אֶת־ אֵיל֔וֹת וַיְשִׁיבֶ֖הָ לִֽיהוּדָ֑ה אַחֲרֵ֥י שְׁכַֽב־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ עִם־ אֲבֹתָֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: hū bā·nāh ’eṯ- ’ê·lō·wṯ way·šî·ḇe·hā lî·hū·ḏāh ’a·ḥă·rê šə·ḵaḇ- ham·me·leḵ ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw
verses.literal: Uzziah was the one who rebuilt Eloth and restored it to Judah after King Amaziah rested with his fathers
verses.literalPt: Este edificou a Elote, e a restituiu a Judá, depois que o rei dormiu com seus pais.

verses.original: בֶּן־ שֵׁ֨שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ עֻזִּיָּ֣הוּ בְמָלְכ֔וֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וּשְׁתַּ֙יִם֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ יְכִילְיָה מִן־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ben- šêš ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh ‘uz·zî·yā·hū ḇə·mā·lə·ḵōw wa·ḥă·miš·šîm ū·šə·ta·yim šā·nāh mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim wə·šêm ’im·mōw yə·ḵī·lə·yå̄h min- yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Uzziah was sixteen . . . years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-two . . . years His mother’s name was Jecoliah she was from Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Tinha Uzias dezesseis anos quando começou a reinar, e cinqüenta e cinco anos reinou em Jerusalém; e era o nome de sua mãe Jecolia, de Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֖ה אֲמַצְיָ֥הוּ אָבִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh ’ă·maṣ·yā·hū ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD just as his father Amaziah had done
verses.literalPt: E fez o que era reto aos olhos do SENHOR; conforme a tudo o que fizera Amazias seu pai.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ לִדְרֹ֣שׁ אֱלֹהִ֔ים בִּימֵ֣י זְכַרְיָ֔הוּ הַמֵּבִ֖ין בִּרְאֹ֣ת הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וּבִימֵי֙ דָּרְשׁ֣וֹ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה הִצְלִיח֖וֹ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî liḏ·rōš ’ĕ·lō·hîm bî·mê zə·ḵar·yā·hū ham·mê·ḇîn bir·’ōṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ū·ḇî·mê dā·rə·šōw ’eṯ- Yah·weh hiṣ·lî·ḥōw hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: He sought God throughout the days of Zechariah who instructed him in the fear of God And as long as he sought the LORD God gave him success
verses.literalPt: Porque deu-se a buscar a Deus nos dias de Zacarias, que era entendido nas visões de Deus; e nos dias em que buscou ao SENHOR, Deus o fez prosperar.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵא֙ וַיִּלָּ֣חֶם בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַיִּפְרֹ֞ץ אֶת־ ח֣וֹמַת גַּ֗ת וְאֵת֙ חוֹמַ֣ת יַבְנֵ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת חוֹמַ֣ת אַשְׁדּ֑וֹד וַיִּבְנֶ֣ה עָרִ֔ים בְּאַשְׁדּ֖וֹד וּבַפְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê way·yil·lā·ḥem bap·pə·liš·tîm way·yip̄·rōṣ ’eṯ- ḥō·w·maṯ gaṯ wə·’êṯ ḥō·w·maṯ yaḇ·nêh wə·’êṯ ḥō·w·maṯ ’aš·dō·wḏ way·yiḇ·neh ‘ā·rîm bə·’aš·dō·wḏ ū·ḇap·pə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: Uzziah went out to wage war against the Philistines and he tore down the walls of Gath - Jabneh and Ashdod Then he built cities near Ashdod and among the Philistines
verses.literalPt: Porque saiu e guerreou contra os filisteus, e quebrou o muro de Gate, o muro de Jabne, e o muro de Asdode; e edificou cidades em Asdode, e entre os filisteus.

verses.original: וַיַּעְזְרֵ֨הוּ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֜ים עַל־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֧ים וְעַל־ הָעַרְבִיִּים הַיֹּשְׁבִ֥ים בְּגוּר־ בָּ֖עַל וְהַמְּעוּנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya‘·zə·rê·hū hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘al- pə·liš·tîm wə·‘al- hå̄·ʿar·ḇī·yīm hay·yō·šə·ḇîm bə·ḡūr- bā·‘al wə·ham·mə·‘ū·nîm
verses.literal: God helped him against the Philistines against the Arabs living in Gur-baal and against the Meunites
verses.literalPt: E Deus o ajudou contra os filisteus e contra os árabes que habitavam em Gur-Baal, e contra os meunitas.

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנ֧וּ הָֽעַמּוֹנִ֛ים מִנְחָ֖ה לְעֻזִּיָּ֑הוּ וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ שְׁמוֹ֙ עַד־ לְב֣וֹא מִצְרַ֔יִם כִּ֥י הֶחֱזִ֖יק עַד־ לְמָֽעְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·nū hā·‘am·mō·w·nîm min·ḥāh lə·‘uz·zî·yā·hū way·yê·leḵ šə·mōw ‘aḏ- lə·ḇō·w miṣ·ra·yim kî he·ḥĕ·zîq ‘aḏ- lə·mā·‘ə·lāh
verses.literal: The Ammonites brought tribute to Uzziah and his fame spread as far as the border of Egypt for he had become exceedingly powerful
verses.literalPt: E os amonitas deram presentes a Uzias; e o seu nome foi espalhado até à entrada do Egito, porque se fortificou altamente.

verses.original: וַיִּ֨בֶן עֻזִּיָּ֤הוּ מִגְדָּלִים֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם עַל־ שַׁ֧עַר הַפִּנָּ֛ה וְעַל־ שַׁ֥עַר הַגַּ֖יְא וְעַל־ הַמִּקְצ֑וֹעַ וַֽיְחַזְּקֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen ‘uz·zî·yā·hū miḡ·dā·lîm bî·rū·šā·lim ‘al- ša·‘ar hap·pin·nāh wə·‘al- ša·‘ar hag·gay wə·‘al- ham·miq·ṣō·w·a‘ way·ḥaz·zə·qêm
verses.literal: Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the Corner . . . Gate the Valley . . . Gate and the angle in the wall and he fortified them
verses.literalPt: Também Uzias edificou torres em Jerusalém, à porta da esquina, e à porta do vale, e à porta do ângulo, e as fortificou.

verses.original: וַיִּ֨בֶן מִגְדָּלִ֜ים בַּמִּדְבָּ֗ר וַיַּחְצֹב֙ בֹּר֣וֹת רַבִּ֔ים כִּ֤י מִקְנֶה־ רַּב֙ הָ֣יָה ל֔וֹ וּבַשְּׁפֵלָ֖ה וּבַמִּישׁ֑וֹר אִכָּרִ֣ים וְכֹֽרְמִ֗ים בֶּהָרִים֙ וּבַכַּרְמֶ֔ל כִּֽי־ אֹהֵ֥ב אֲדָמָ֖ה הָיָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen miḡ·dā·lîm bam·miḏ·bār way·yaḥ·ṣōḇ bō·rō·wṯ rab·bîm kî miq·neh- raḇ hā·yāh lōw ū·ḇaš·šə·p̄ê·lāh ū·ḇam·mî·šō·wr ’ik·kā·rîm wə·ḵō·rə·mîm be·hā·rîm ū·ḇak·kar·mel kî- ’ō·hêḇ ’ă·ḏā·māh hā·yāh
verses.literal: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain he built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns And since he was a lover of the soil he had farmers and vinedressers in the hill country and in the fertile fields
verses.literalPt: Também edificou torres no deserto, e cavou muitos poços, porque tinha muito gado, tanto nos vales como nas campinas; tinha lavradores, e vinhateiros, nos montes e nos campos férteis; porque era amigo da agricultura.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י לְעֻזִּיָּ֡הוּ חַיִל֩ עֹשֵׂ֨ה מִלְחָמָ֜ה יוֹצְאֵ֧י צָבָ֣א לִגְד֗וּד בְּמִסְפַּר֙ פְּקֻדָּתָ֔ם בְּיַד֙ יְעוּאֵל הַסּוֹפֵ֔ר וּמַעֲשֵׂיָ֖הוּ הַשּׁוֹטֵ֑ר עַ֚ל יַד־ חֲנַנְיָ֔הוּ מִשָּׂרֵ֖י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî lə·‘uz·zî·yā·hū ḥa·yil ‘ō·śêh mil·ḥā·māh yō·wṣ·’ê ṣā·ḇā liḡ·ḏūḏ bə·mis·par pə·qud·dā·ṯām bə·yaḏ yə·ʿū·ʾēl has·sō·w·p̄êr ū·ma·‘ă·śê·yā·hū haš·šō·w·ṭêr ‘al yaḏ- ḥă·nan·yā·hū miś·śā·rê ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Uzziah had an army ready for battle that went out to war by assigned divisions . . . as recorded by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer under the direction of Hananiah one of the royal officers
verses.literalPt: Tinha também Uzias um exército de homens destros na guerra, que saíam à guerra em tropas, segundo o número da resenha feita por mão de Jeiel, o escrivão, e Maaséias, oficial, sob a direção de Hananias, um dos capitães do rei.

verses.original: כֹּ֠ל מִסְפַּ֞ר רָאשֵׁ֤י הָאָבוֹת֙ לְגִבּ֣וֹרֵי חָ֔יִל אַלְפַּ֖יִם וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: kōl mis·par rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ lə·ḡib·bō·w·rê ḥā·yil ’al·pa·yim wə·šêš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: The total number of family leaders of the mighty men of valor was 2,600 . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: O total dos chefes dos pais, homens valentes, era de dois mil e seiscentos.

verses.original: וְעַל־ יָדָם֩ חֵ֨יל צָבָ֜א שְׁלֹ֧שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אֶ֗לֶף וְשִׁבְעַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ וַחֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת עוֹשֵׂ֥י מִלְחָמָ֖ה בְּכֹ֣חַ חָ֑יִל לַעְזֹ֥ר לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ עַל־ הָאוֹיֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- yā·ḏām ḥêl ṣā·ḇā šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ ’e·lep̄ wə·šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm wa·ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ ‘ō·w·śê mil·ḥā·māh bə·ḵō·aḥ ḥā·yil la‘·zōr lam·me·leḵ ‘al- hā·’ō·w·yêḇ
verses.literal: Under their authority was an army . . . of 307,500 . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . trained for war a powerful force to support the king against his enemies
verses.literalPt: E debaixo das suas ordens havia um exército guerreiro de trezentos e sete mil e quinhentos homens, que faziam a guerra com força belicosa, para ajudar o rei contra os inimigos.

verses.original: וַיָּכֶן֩ לָהֶ֨ם עֻזִּיָּ֜הוּ לְכָל־ הַצָּבָ֗א מָגִנִּ֤ים וּרְמָחִים֙ וְכ֣וֹבָעִ֔ים וְשִׁרְיֹנ֖וֹת וּקְשָׁת֑וֹת וּלְאַבְנֵ֖י קְלָעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḵen lā·hem ‘uz·zî·yā·hū lə·ḵāl haṣ·ṣā·ḇā mā·ḡin·nîm ū·rə·mā·ḥîm wə·ḵō·w·ḇā·‘îm wə·šir·yō·nō·wṯ ū·qə·šā·ṯō·wṯ ū·lə·’aḇ·nê qə·lā·‘îm
verses.literal: Uzziah supplied . . . the entire army with shields spears helmets armor bows and slingstones . . .
verses.literalPt: E preparou Uzias, para todo o exército, escudos, lanças, capacetes, couraças e arcos, e até fundas para atirar pedras.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ׀ בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם חִשְּׁבֹנ֜וֹת מַחֲשֶׁ֣בֶת חוֹשֵׁ֗ב לִהְי֤וֹת עַל־ הַמִּגְדָּלִים֙ וְעַל־ הַפִּנּ֔וֹת לִירוֹא֙ בַּֽחִצִּ֔ים וּבָאֲבָנִ֖ים גְּדֹל֑וֹת וַיֵּצֵ֤א שְׁמוֹ֙ עַד־ לְמֵ֣רָח֔וֹק כִּֽי־ הִפְלִ֥יא לְהֵעָזֵ֖ר עַ֥ד כִּֽי־ חָזָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś bî·rū·šā·lim ḥiš·šə·ḇō·nō·wṯ ma·ḥă·še·ḇeṯ ḥō·wō·šêḇ lih·yō·wṯ ‘al- ham·miḡ·dā·lîm wə·‘al- hap·pin·nō·wṯ lî·rō·w ba·ḥiṣ·ṣîm ū·ḇā·’ă·ḇā·nîm gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ way·yê·ṣê šə·mōw ‘aḏ- lə·mê·rā·ḥō·wq kî- hip̄·lî lə·hê·‘ā·zêr ‘aḏ kî- ḥā·zāq
verses.literal: And in Jerusalem he made skillfully designed devices to shoot arrows and catapult large stones from the towers and corners So his fame spread far and wide for he was helped tremendously until . . . he became powerful
verses.literalPt: Também fez em Jerusalém máquinas da invenção de engenheiros, que estivessem nas torres e nos cantos, para atirarem flechas e grandes pedras; e propagou a sua fama até muito longe; porque foi maravilhosamente ajudado, até que se fortificou.

verses.original: וּכְחֶזְקָת֗וֹ גָּבַ֤הּ לִבּוֹ֙ עַד־ לְהַשְׁחִ֔ית וַיִּמְעַ֖ל בַּיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־ הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה לְהַקְטִ֖יר עַל־ מִזְבַּ֥ח הַקְּטֹֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·ḥez·qā·ṯōw gā·ḇah lib·bōw ‘aḏ- lə·haš·ḥîṯ way·yim·‘al Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw way·yā·ḇō ’el- hê·ḵal Yah·weh lə·haq·ṭîr ‘al- miz·baḥ haq·qə·ṭō·reṯ
verses.literal: But when Uzziah became powerful his arrogance . . . led to his own destruction He was unfaithful to the LORD his God for he entered . . . the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense
verses.literalPt: Mas, havendo-se já fortificado, exaltou-se o seu coração até se corromper; e transgrediu contra o SENHOR seu Deus, porque entrou no templo do SENHOR para queimar incenso no altar do incenso.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א אַחֲרָ֖יו עֲזַרְיָ֣הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְעִמּ֞וֹ כֹּהֲנִ֧ים׀ לַיהוָ֛ה שְׁמוֹנִ֖ים בְּנֵי־ חָֽיִל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’a·ḥă·rāw ‘ă·zar·yā·hū hak·kō·hên wə·‘im·mōw kō·hă·nîm Yah·weh šə·mō·w·nîm bə·nê- ḥā·yil
verses.literal: Then Azariah the priest along with eighty . . . brave priests of the LORD went in after him
verses.literalPt: Porém o sacerdote Azarias entrou após ele, e com ele oitenta sacerdotes do SENHOR, homens valentes.

verses.original: וַיַּעַמְד֞וּ עַל־ עֻזִּיָּ֣הוּ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וַיֹּ֤אמְרוּ לוֹ֙ לֹא־ לְךָ֣ עֻזִּיָּ֗הוּ לְהַקְטִיר֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה כִּ֣י לַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים בְּנֵי־ אַהֲרֹ֛ן הַמְקֻדָּשִׁ֖ים לְהַקְטִ֑יר צֵ֤א מִן־ הַמִּקְדָּשׁ֙ כִּ֣י מָעַ֔לְתָּ וְלֹֽא־ לְךָ֥ לְכָב֖וֹד מֵיְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘am·ḏū ‘al- ‘uz·zî·yā·hū ham·me·leḵ way·yō·mə·rū lōw lō- lə·ḵā ‘uz·zî·yā·hū lə·haq·ṭîr Yah·weh kî lak·kō·hă·nîm bə·nê- ’a·hă·rōn ham·qud·dā·šîm lə·haq·ṭîr ṣê min- ham·miq·dāš kî mā·‘al·tā wə·lō- lə·ḵā lə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: They took their stand against King Uzziah and said Uzziah you have no right to offer incense to the LORD Only the priests the descendants of Aaron are consecrated to burn incense Leave the sanctuary for you have acted unfaithfully you will not receive honor from the LORD God
verses.literalPt: E resistiram ao rei Uzias, e lhe disseram: A ti, Uzias, não compete queimar incenso perante o SENHOR, mas aos sacerdotes, filhos de Arão, que são consagrados para queimar incenso; sai do santuário, porque transgrediste; e não será isto para honra tua da parte do SENHOR Deus.

verses.original: וַיִּזְעַף֙ עֻזִּיָּ֔הוּ וּבְיָד֥וֹ מִקְטֶ֖רֶת לְהַקְטִ֑יר וּבְזַעְפּ֣וֹ עִם־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וְ֠הַצָּרַעַת זָרְחָ֨ה בְמִצְח֜וֹ לִפְנֵ֤י הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה מֵעַ֖ל לְמִזְבַּ֥ח הַקְּטֹֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·‘ap̄ ‘uz·zî·yā·hū ū·ḇə·yā·ḏōw miq·ṭe·reṯ lə·haq·ṭîr ū·ḇə·za‘·pōw ‘im- hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·haṣ·ṣā·ra·‘aṯ zā·rə·ḥāh ḇə·miṣ·ḥōw lip̄·nê hak·kō·hă·nîm bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh mê·‘al lə·miz·baḥ haq·qə·ṭō·reṯ
verses.literal: Uzziah with a censer in his hand to offer incense was enraged But while he raged against the priests in their presence . . . in the house of the LORD before the altar of incense leprosy broke out on his forehead
verses.literalPt: Então Uzias se indignou; e tinha o incensário na sua mão para queimar incenso. Indignando-se ele, pois, contra os sacerdotes, a lepra lhe saiu à testa perante os sacerdotes, na casa do SENHOR, junto ao altar do incenso.

verses.original: וַיִּ֣פֶן אֵלָ֡יו עֲזַרְיָהוּ֩ כֹהֵ֨ן הָרֹ֜אשׁ וְכָל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וְהִנֵּה־ ה֤וּא מְצֹרָע֙ בְּמִצְח֔וֹ וַיַּבְהִל֖וּהוּ מִשָּׁ֑ם וְגַם־ הוּא֙ נִדְחַ֣ף לָצֵ֔את כִּ֥י נִגְּע֖וֹ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·p̄en ’ê·lāw ‘ă·zar·yā·hū ḵō·hên hā·rōš wə·ḵāl hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hin·nêh- hū mə·ṣō·rā‘ bə·miṣ·ḥōw way·yaḇ·hi·lū·hū miš·šām wə·ḡam- hū niḏ·ḥap̄ lā·ṣêṯ kî nig·gə·‘ōw Yah·weh
verses.literal: When Azariah the chief priest and all the priests turned to him and saw his leprous forehead they rushed him out Indeed he himself hurried to get out because the LORD had afflicted him
verses.literalPt: Então o sumo sacerdote Azarias olhou para ele, como também todos os sacerdotes, e eis que já estava leproso na sua testa, e apressuradamente o lançaram fora; e até ele mesmo se deu pressa a sair, visto que o SENHOR o ferira.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ עֻזִּיָּ֨הוּ הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ מְצֹרָ֣ע׀ עַד־ י֣וֹם מוֹת֗וֹ וַיֵּ֜שֶׁב בֵּ֤ית הַחָפְשׁוּת מְצֹרָ֔ע כִּ֥י נִגְזַ֖ר מִבֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וְיוֹתָ֤ם בְּנוֹ֙ עַל־ בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ שׁוֹפֵ֖ט אֶת־ עַ֥ם הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ‘uz·zî·yā·hū ham·me·leḵ mə·ṣō·rā‘ ‘aḏ- yō·wm mō·w·ṯōw way·yê·šeḇ bêṯ ha·ḥå̄·p̄ə·šūṯ mə·ṣō·rā‘ kî niḡ·zar mib·bêṯ Yah·weh wə·yō·w·ṯām bə·nōw ‘al- bêṯ ham·me·leḵ šō·w·p̄êṭ ’eṯ- ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: So King Uzziah was a leper until the day of his death He lived in isolation leprous and cut off from the house of the LORD while his son Jotham had charge of the royal palace and governed the people of the land
verses.literalPt: Assim ficou leproso o rei Uzias até ao dia da sua morte; e morou, por ser leproso, numa casa separada, porque foi excluído da casa do SENHOR. E Jotão, seu filho, tinha o encargo da casa do rei, julgando o povo da terra.

verses.original: וְיֶ֙תֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י עֻזִּיָּ֔הוּ הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְהָאֲחֲרֹנִ֑ים כָּתַ֛ב יְשַֽׁעְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־ אָמ֖וֹץ הַנָּבִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê ‘uz·zî·yā·hū hā·ri·šō·nîm wə·hå̄·ʾă·ḥă·rō·nīm kā·ṯaḇ yə·ša‘·yā·hū ḇen- ’ā·mō·wṣ han·nā·ḇî
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Uzziah from beginning to end they are recorded by the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz
verses.literalPt: Quanto ao mais dos atos de Uzias, tanto os primeiros como os últimos, o profeta Isaías, filho de Amós, o escreveu.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֨ב עֻזִּיָּ֜הוּ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֗יו וַיִּקְבְּר֨וּ אֹת֤וֹ עִם־ אֲבֹתָיו֙ בִּשְׂדֵ֤ה הַקְּבוּרָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַמְּלָכִ֔ים כִּ֥י אָמְר֖וּ מְצוֹרָ֣ע ה֑וּא וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יוֹתָ֥ם בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ ‘uz·zî·yā·hū ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw way·yiq·bə·rū ’ō·ṯōw ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw biś·ḏêh haq·qə·ḇū·rāh ’ă·šer lam·mə·lā·ḵîm kî ’ā·mə·rū mə·ṣō·w·rā‘ hū way·yim·lōḵ yō·w·ṯām bə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Uzziah rested with his fathers and was buried near them in a field of burial that belonged to the kings for the people said He was a leper And his son Jotham reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: E dormiu Uzias com seus pais, e o sepultaram com eles no campo do sepulcro que era dos reis; porque disseram: Leproso é. E Jotão, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
